name: NFO Mirror
description: Mirrors Jellyfin's NFO files for movies, shows, seasons and episodes into a writable NFO root instead of next to the media files, and reads them back.
overview: Write and read Kodi .nfo files in a separate folder when media is read-only

versions.changelog: Fix full sync moving NFOs of alternate versions (e.g. two files for one episode) to .orphans. Log every moved orphan and a breakdown of skipped items. Config page warns when the Nfo reader is ranked above NFO Mirror (12.4 has no reader checkbox).
